bio: A genuine oasis of sophistication! This impressive restaurant, overseen by Chef Luis Mourão, enjoys a privileged setting in the EPIC SANA Algarve Hotel, beside Falésia Beach – a paradise surrounded by greenery and natural beauty. In a spacious glass-fronted kitchen, visible from the elegant dining room decorated in warm tones, the chef creates dishes that balance traditional Portuguese – especially Algarvian – cookery with recipes bearing his own signature. The offering, crafted from the finest seasonal ingredients nature provides, comprises three tasting menus: Água (celebrating fresh fish and seafood), Fogo (centred on outstanding meats) and Terra (born of vegetables)....
